task.description:
Validate the fix design for ISS-0112 per WF-03 Step 2b (hard gate). Review src/design/fix-iss0112-secret-ref.md and verify:

1. Design addresses the root cause (missing secret_ref column in SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas)
2. Migration covers all SCHEMA-mode tenants (not just tenant_default)
3. Migration is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS, safe to run multiple times)
4. Migration is NON-GBL (will run against tenant schemas)
5. No implementation code present - design only
6. Validation steps are specified
7. Design follows existing patterns from GBL-133 and GBL-116
8. Both secret_ref AND secret_key_id columns are added (per GBL-128)
9. Schema name construction is correct (tenant_default vs tenant_{uuid})

This is a HARD GATE - BACKEND-DEV cannot start Step 3 until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: No implementation code in design file

result.summary: Design validation PASS: src/design/fix-iss0112-secret-ref.md addresses all acceptance criteria. Migration 134 is NON-GBL, covers all SCHEMA-mode tenants via dynamic iteration, adds both secret_ref and secret_key_id columns with IF NOT EXISTS idempotency, includes comprehensive validation steps, and follows established patterns from GBL-133/GBL-116/GBL-128. No implementation code present (design-only). Ready for BACKEND-DEV implementation.
